purpose: Known-input/known-output pairs for the identity-change-ack signing protocol. Same protocol as the matrix and replacement-notice: JCS-canonicalize the wrapper, SHA-256 digest, Ed25519 sign the digest. The Kotlin client signer must produce byte-identical canonical bytes, digest, and signature to the TS reference.

signed_object_shape.description: The signed unit is the wrapper with domain separation.
signed_object_shape.digest: SHA-256 over the JCS-canonical bytes of the wrapper
signed_object_shape.signature: Ed25519 over the 32-byte digest (standard Ed25519, NOT Ed25519ph)

test_only_key_derivation.note: Same test key as canonical-matrix-test-vectors.json and canonical-replacement-notice-test-vectors.json. Same seed, same info string.

vectors.description: Baseline. Valid ack with accept decision.
